Nestle India Ltd.: Q2FY27 Revenue Growth
: Nestle India (NESTLEIND): Q2FY27 revenue INR 67.8bn (+20% YoY), exports +22%, gross margin 56.9% (+260bp), EBITDA INR 16.2bn (+29%). Brokers cut targets 7–17%, implying ~9–19% upside.
Nestle India Ltd.: Domestic Growth, Ad Spend
: NESTLEIND reports broad-based domestic sales growth and higher ad/marketing spend, while maintaining productivity and brand investments to offset commodity cost pressures.
Nestle India Ltd.: Prices May Change
: Nestle India (NESTLEIND) warns prices may change after the festive season; any hikes will depend on commodity trends and consumer demand, possibly after Diwali.
FSSAI Notice To Nestle India Ltd.
: FSSAI issued a notice to Nestle India Ltd. (NESTLEIND) over alleged misleading labeling of several Nescafé products on e‑commerce, citing discrepancies between front‑ and back‑of‑pack declarations.

: Nestle India (NESTLEIND) pushes Nescafé growth via higher investment, wider reach and better e‑commerce and channel execution, boosting brand penetration and premium sales.
